rationale: Adds portable full-plan ZIP backup with actual image bytes, saved Zigbee snapshot and coherent restore/Undo, which did not exist in v1.81.0. Legacy JSON transfer remains supported. This is a new user capability, not internal-cycle polish.

summary.ru: Полная ZIP-копия переносит план вместе с картинками и сохранёнными связями Zigbee.
summary.en: Full ZIP backups transfer the plan together with used images and saved Zigbee links.
